units.source_text: 白居易《香炉峰下新卜山居草堂初成》诗中句云：“遗爱寺钟欹枕听，香炉峰雪拨帘看。”

en.t: A line in Bai Juyi's poem Newly Choosing a Mountain Residence Beneath Incense Burner Peak, the Thatched Hall Just Completed says: "I listen to the bell of Yi'ai Temple while leaning on my pillow, and lift the curtain to look at the snow on Incense Burner Peak."
